text.card: A red giant 1,088 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.30 solar masses and 20.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,532 K at its surface.
